name: launch-github-project
description: Turn a local project into a GitHub release people can understand, try, and verify.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare a clear, verifiable GitHub release.
interface.longDescription: Audits the real project, builds only the public surface its type needs, checks public risk, generates evidence-based Release pages, packages a deterministic bundle, and keeps remote actions behind explicit authorization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $launch-github-project to audit this project read-only, prepare the smallest verifiable public surface it needs, and list every decision required before any remote action.
